displayPattern: Amber status LED on a Carrier Infinity 25VNA8 heat pump or 24VNA9 air conditioner. A short flash is 0.25 seconds on and a long flash is 1.0 second on. Code 49 is 4 short and 9 long
meaning: Compressor overcurrent fault. The control elevates this to fault 95 after 5 occurrences. Reset time is 6 minutes.
causes: The service manual points code 49 at the fault 95 cause list
Compressor operating outside its allowed envelope, or high superheat
Incoming power supply voltage, loose power leads, or a phase imbalance
Outdoor airflow too low, refrigerant overcharge, inverter damage, or compressor internal damage
diySteps: Count 4 short flashes and 9 long flashes. With power off, look at the outdoor coil for ice or debris. That is the airflow line on the fault 95 table this code points to
Technician: follow fault 95. Charge, winding resistance, voltage against the rating plate, and inverter or compressor replacement are that table
safetyNote: Outdoor units carry line voltage even when the thermostat is off. Switch off the unit's disconnect and breaker before touching anything. Refrigerant, wiring, compressor and control-board work must be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician if 49 repeats. Five occurrences become the 2-hour lockout 95.
sourceTitle: Carrier Infinity 25VNA8 heat pump / 24VNA9 air conditioner Service Manual (4SM)
